name: Bench2Drive-V0.0.4
description: Bench2Drive-V0.0.4 is a benchmark dataset for evaluating autonomous-driving and driving-assistant models across perception and decision-making tasks. It combines sensor/visual inputs and scenario annotations to measure object understanding, trajectory prediction, and driving action quality under diverse driving situations.
evaluation_method: task-dependent (mAP for detection; ADE/FDE for trajectory prediction; task_success_rate or safety metrics for planning/control)
reputation: A niche dataset maintained by RethinkLab with limited but growing use in AV research and internal evaluations.
